lessons_used: Predictions were generally too optimistic, but underestimated gains on winning home wait_info tests.
Adding new screens at adoption (2 tests) or finish (2 tests) consistently hurt performance and required early stops.
Home wait_info changes (11 tests) were helpful in three winning tests, while eight showed no clear effect.

Reordering sign-in steps (2 tests), adding sign-in hints (2 tests), modifying finish layouts (2 tests), changing finish copy (2 tests), and home redesigns (2 tests) consistently showed no clear effect.
Evidence remains thin for categories with only one test or with conflicting results across tests.

candidates.title: Stage Layout Generation Care Station
candidates.change: Redesign the waiting screen into a stage layout featuring live activity progress indicators and pet care tips while pet generation completes.
candidates.why: The home step has a long median wait time of 201s, and wait_info improvements on the home screen have historically proven to be the most effective optimization area.

guard.reason: Redesigning the waiting screen layout while keeping progress and time estimates preserves its core job.

candidates.score_note: Home drop-off is low (8.4%) and home redesigns historically showed no clear effect.

candidates.title: Full Bleed Mascot Story Intro
candidates.change: Redesign the story screen into a full-bleed layout featuring an animated pet mascot welcoming new users.
candidates.why: 20.6% of users drop off at the choose_path stage; an immersive hero visual on the story screen builds immediate emotional investment.

guard.reason: Redesigning the story screen with a mascot layout retains the pet introduction purpose.

candidates.score_note: Choose path drop-off is 20.6%; choose_path redesigns previously yielded +2.5% across 2 tests.

candidates.title: Card Layout Companion Selector
candidates.change: Redesign the pick_friend screen using interactive selection cards with styled companion previews.
candidates.why: Adoption suffers a 29.1% drop-off rate and high mean time (1017s); structured choice cards make companion selection clearer and faster.

guard.reason: Redesigning the pick_friend screen with selection cards maintains the pet selection job.

candidates.score_note: Adoption step drops 29.1% with long wait times; adoption redesigns yielded +3.7% in past tests.

candidates.title: Compact Account Sign-In View
candidates.change: Redesign the sign-in screen into a compact layout focusing on account persistence and pet data protection.
candidates.why: Sign-in sees a 27.1% drop-off and 8 support tickets reported missing or reset pets after re-authenticating.

sign_in.headline: Save Your Companion's Progress
sign_in.body: Sign in to ensure your pet is saved to your account and accessible across sessions without reset.

guard.reason: Redesigning the sign_in screen into a compact view preserves sign-in functionality.

candidates.score_note: High drop-off (27.1%) and 8 support tickets, but full redesigns carry execution risk.

candidates.title: Desktop Docking Ready Notification Stream
candidates.change: Add a completion notification option and dynamic time estimate banner to the waiting screen.
candidates.why: With a median wait of 201s on the home waiting screen, proactive ready notifications reduce user anxiety and drop-off during generation.

waiting.hint: We will notify you the moment your pet is ready to dock on your desktop.

guard.reason: Adding completion notifications and dynamic estimates to the waiting screen is permitted inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Home wait_info changes have strong historical winning precedent for reducing 201s wait drop-offs.

candidates.title: Account Sync & Pet Data Protection Notice
candidates.change: Update sign-in copy to explicitly inform users that signing in prevents pet data reset and links pets to their profile.
candidates.why: Support received 8 tickets regarding pets missing or resetting after signing back into the application.

sign_in.headline: Secure Your Pet to Your Account
sign_in.body: Signing in links your pet safely to your account profile so your companion is never lost when restarting.

guard.reason: Updating sign-in copy to detail pet data protection is an allowed onboarding text change.

candidates.score_note: Strong alignment between support tickets (8) and funnel drop-off; cheap copy update to test.

candidates.title: Centered Journey Path Cards
candidates.change: Switch the choose_path screen layout to a centered design with a step progress counter.
candidates.why: 20.4% of starting users drop off at choose_path; a centered layout focuses user attention on path selection.

guard.reason: Changing choose_path layout and adding a progress counter is allowed inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Choose_path layout changes previously showed a net negative (-0.8%) across 2 tests.

candidates.title: Custom Photo Quality Guidance Banner
candidates.change: Display explicit lighting and clarity instructions on the photo upload screen.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or distorted output visuals.

upload_photos.hint: Use well-lit, clear front-facing photos for optimal custom pet generation.

guard.reason: Asks for personal photos of the user.

candidates.title: Desktop Controls & Visibility Guide Copy
candidates.change: Provide clear onboarding finish copy explaining system tray access and desktop companion visibility controls.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported pets not appearing on desktop and 3 reported confusion regarding controlling or hiding the pet after setup.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!
home_intro.body: Look for your companion on screen. Use the system tray icon to hide, show, or control your pet anytime.

guard.reason: Updating home_intro copy to explain desktop controls is allowed as home_intro is part of onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Strong support mail alignment, but historical finish copy changes consistently showed no clear effect (-0.6%).

candidates.title: First Companion Accessory Unlock Badge
candidates.change: Add an unlocked starter item badge component on the adoption certificate screen to celebrate completion.
candidates.why: Adoption has a 29.1% drop-off; providing a visual reward badge increases user motivation to finish setup.

guard.reason: Promoting an unlocked starter accessory in onboarding copy violates Rule 3 prohibiting mentions of gifts or free extras.

lessons_next: Predictions were generally too optimistic overall, but underestimated gains on winning home wait_info tests.
Adding new screens at adoption (2 tests) or finish (2 tests) consistently hurt performance and caused early stops.
Home wait_info changes (12 tests) were helpful in four winning tests, though eight showed no clear effect.
Sign-in hints (2 tests), sign-in reordering (2 tests), finish copy changes (3 tests), finish layout changes (2 tests), and home redesigns (2 tests) consistently showed no clear effect.
Evidence remains thin or inconsistent for categories with only one test or conflicting results across tests.
